ore:Proxy.dc:description: The Parisian undergound stations takes the name from the Greek mount Parnassus which was, according to Greek mythology the residence of the God Appollo and the home of the Muses. In this picture we see the underground train crossing the tunel at the entranc to which we can read "direction Montparnasse" so "to Mount Parnassus".
